discussion.body:
Please use the following as the character's background. Anything reminiscent of Pokémon, should be rebranded or assumed a coincidence and not related.
The monster in question started out as an adolescent squirtle trying to train his way into success by protecting and caring for his family. But then, a group of adventurers came through and hunted almost all of his family and friends for their turtle meat as a simple gesture for a town merchant who liked the taste of their meat. The once gentle little squirtle was twisted by hatred and revenge and turned into the grotesque monster we now see hell bent on avenging every single one of his friends and family.
